name: Greg Lauren
why: Ralph's nephew deconstructing the family mythology — one-of-one garments rebuilt from vintage military cloth, tents, and denim in an LA studio.
origin: Greg Lauren — painter, and Ralph's nephew — began cutting garments from vintage textiles in his LA studio, 2011; the family dream, distressed.
opview: Frames the work as deconstructing the American uniform — the dream taken apart at the seams.

notes.craft: one-of-one construction from vintage cloth in an owned LA studio
notes.murica: Americana literally recut — the flag frayed on purpose
